references.text: The context for the Sabbath year that forms the basis for calculating the Jubilee year - seven Sabbath years.
Describes the actual Jubilee year that follows the forty-nine years - the fiftieth year.
Parallel structure with counting of seven weeks (seven times seven days) up to Pentecost, mirroring the counting of seven Sabbath years.
Daniel's prophecy of seventy weeks (seven times seven) uses a similar numerical structure based on the Sabbath year cycle.
The fundamental law concerning the Sabbath year as the land's rest, which is the basis for the calculation in Leviticus 25:8.
Regulations regarding the Year of Release every seventh year, which constitutes the basic unit in Jubilee calculations.
The fulfillment of the Sabbath years that the land did not receive rest, linked to the cycle of seven Sabbath years.
Prophetic fulfillment of the Jubilee's liberation, which Jesus quotes in Luke 4.
